diagnostics.name: field-from-unrelated-map
diagnostics.message: A register block may consume only field handles owned by its RegisterMap.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use the corresponding field from the block's map or instantiate the matching RegisterBlock.

diagnostics.name: missing-register-transport
diagnostics.message: No RegisterTransport instance is available for the attached bus type.
diagnostics.suggestion: Import or define one capability-declaring RegisterTransport for the bus type.

diagnostics.name: symbolic-fixed-register-offset
diagnostics.message: A fixed register offset cannot be supplied by a symbolic parameter.
diagnostics.suggestion: Keep published offsets constant and use explicit symbolic array or layout geometry where configurability is intentional.

diagnostics.name: hardware-binding-type-mismatch
diagnostics.message: A hardware binding value does not match the field's declared data type.
diagnostics.suggestion: Bind an expression with the exact field type or use an explicit typed conversion.

diagnostics.name: hardware-operation-field-kind-mismatch
diagnostics.message: A field is used with an incompatible hardware-side operation.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use set/clear for Boolean fields and increment/decrement only for compatible numeric fields.

diagnostics.name: duplicate-register-address
diagnostics.message: Two register declarations occupy the same address without an explicit alias contract.
diagnostics.suggestion: Move one register or declare an intentional alias using the alias API.

diagnostics.name: overlapping-field-range
diagnostics.message: Field bit ranges overlap inside one register.
diagnostics.suggestion: Assign disjoint ranges or declare the intended alias/overlay semantics explicitly.

diagnostics.name: register-block-without-domain
diagnostics.message: A physical RegisterBlock has no resolved clock/reset domain.
diagnostics.suggestion: Construct the RegisterBlock inside one lexical ClockDomain or bind the required domain explicitly.

diagnostics.name: multiple-direct-register-transports
diagnostics.message: More than one transport is attached directly to one physical register block.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use an explicit register-access arbiter/router with declared ordering and priority.

diagnostics.name: dynamic-value-captured-by-register-map
diagnostics.message: An immutable RegisterMap captures a live hardware value as ABI metadata.
diagnostics.suggestion: Keep reset and layout metadata constant or symbolic and bind live signals on RegisterBlock.

diagnostics.name: illegal-register-field-policy-combination
diagnostics.message: The selected software, hardware, collision, or partial-write policies are incompatible.
diagnostics.suggestion: Choose a supported orthogonal policy combination or an explicit custom extension approved by the API.

diagnostics.name: unsafe-cross-domain-register-binding
diagnostics.message: A register field binding samples a value from an unrelated domain without an explicit CDC primitive.
diagnostics.suggestion: Use a typed level, pulse, handshake, snapshot, or FIFO crossing appropriate to the value semantics.
